verdict.rationale: OpenHands is fundamentally an autonomous coding agent with sandboxed execution (Docker/Apptainer runtimes), git integrations, and CLI/cloud modes that imply it can operate within a cloned repo and run setup commands, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents an end-to-end 'clone repo, install dependencies, configure environment' autonomous workflow. missing for 10: explicit documentation or demo of autonomous repo cloning, dependency installation, and self-configuration of the working environment; independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow succeeding.
